hook.text: The IRS proposed taxing some NFTs as collectibles in 2023—at 28%, not the standard 20% capital gains rate.

buildup.text: NFTs are unique tokens representing art, music, or virtual land.

discovery.text: The IRS uses a 'look-through' approach: an NFT representing gold is taxed like gold.

twist.text: An NFT of a tweet sold for $2.9 million. What asset class is a tweet?

climax.text: NFTs push tax law into absurdity. Classifying infinitely diverse digital tokens into rigid categories may be impossible.

punchline.text: Is a tweet art or a collectible? NFTs broke tax classifications wide open.

quiz.question: How does the IRS propose taxing certain NFTs?
